title: Ed4All
subtitle: Active Inference for Grounded Educational Knowledge Environments.
audience: Educators, curriculum designers, and researchers building AI-assisted educational agents that stay within explicit knowledge boundaries.
lede: Ed4All (Active Inference for Grounded Educational Knowledge Environments) is an open, locally deployable, empirically evaluated framework for grounded educational agents that operate within explicit knowledge and evidentiary boundaries.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Ed4All develops educational agents whose responses are grounded in an explicit, bounded body of knowledge and evidence, rather than an open-ended generative model — aimed at classroom and self-directed learning contexts where staying within a defined curriculum or evidence base matters. The framework is designed to run locally and be empirically evaluated rather than deployed as an opaque black box.

sections.heading: Participate
sections.body: Educators, curriculum designers, and developers interested in grounded, evaluable educational AI agents are welcome.
